components.name: Workbench field
components.description: Stable dark field with the desktop workbench's amber keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-workbench-label">Nombre<input class="ds-workbench-field" placeholder="Nombre de la tienda"></label>
components.css: .ds-workbench-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #f2f5f7; font: 13px/1.5 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-workbench-field { min-height: 38px; background: #0b141e; color: #f2f5f7; border: 1px solid rgb(232 242 255 / 0.16); border-radius: 8px; font: 13px Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.03); caret-color: #e8b56f; } .ds-workbench-field::placeholder { color: #8c9cab; opacity: 1; } .ds-workbench-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8b56f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workbench glass panel
components.description: One visible editing panel fills the remaining width without a 768px cap. Tablet/Mobile reserve up to 768px/390px at the right, separated by a 12px gutter. Details occupy the same panel as their lists, which remain mounted to preserve state and scroll. Preview and storefront retain their own styling.
components.css: .ds-workbench-panel { padding: 0 22px 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(232 242 255 / 0.16); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.045), transparent 36%), rgb(13 22 36 / 0.78); color: #f2f5f7; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28), 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.075) inset; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-workbench-panel h2 { padding-top: 20px; font-size: 25px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-shadow: none; } .ds-workbench-panel p { color: #b1bdc8; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; text-shadow: none; }

components.name: Storefront primary action
components.description: Theme-colored public action with a 48px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-storefront-primary { background: var(--solara-accent, #a63d2f); color: var(--solara-accent-text, #fff); min-height: 48px; padding: .75rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--solara-radius, 2px); font: inherit; } .ds-storefront-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--solara-accent, #a63d2f), var(--solara-accent-text, #fff) 28%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Studio panel
components.description: Dark editor surface using the existing panel radius and shadow tokens.
components.css: .ds-studio-panel { background: var(--surface, #111214); color: var(--ink, #f3f0ea); padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgb(255 255 255 / .08)); border-radius: var(--radius-panel, 16px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel, 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.44)); } .ds-studio-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: A precise local workshop with an editorial public face
narrative.overview: SolaraCommerce separates a dense dark editing environment from a theme-driven public storefront. The visual system is evidence-led and preserves the existing renderer, responsive contract and store-owned tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial V2 rhythm without sacrificing utility

rules.name: The Preview Viewport Rule
rules.body: Tablet (768px) and Mobile (390px) describe the iframe's internal viewport, not supported editor device classes. Scale the rendered frame to fit without changing that viewport. Opening the main panel temporarily selects Tablet; device changes while it is open remain temporary, and closing it restores the preset selected before opening. Opening or closing a detail within that panel leaves the preview device, route and zoom unchanged; the device selector remains available. The desktop editor must not be documented as a 320px mobile application.

rules.name: The Stationary Workshop Rule
rules.body: Inherit the dashboard's glass materials, not its animated background; the preview remains the store's own rendered document.

rules.name: The Shared Renderer Rule
rules.body: Preview and export must preserve the same semantic public tree.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Studio tokens stay isolated from storefront tokens.

rules.name: The Useful Final State Rule
rules.body: Motion and responsive states must remain useful when effects are removed.

dos: Do derive public styling from the active store theme.
Do preserve keyboard, reduced-motion and no-JavaScript behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual family during a narrow refinement.
Don't change persisted data or native-agent operations to satisfy a visual finding.
